title: Veterano V4 Reimaginado
prompt: Create a fresh, full-body medieval fantasy Orc Warrior concept as a new PixelLab pixel-art interpretation of the supplied V4 reference image. Keep the V4 identity cues recognizable: olive-green skin, mature angular face, heavy brow, small ivory tusks, amber eyes, a crimson neck scarf, dark iron armor with restrained silver highlights, one distinct asymmetrical steel shoulder plate, practical leather straps and a broad belt. Reinterpret the character for a clean, readable tactical RPG sprite: compact athletic build with strong but not bodybuilder proportions, purposeful asymmetry, expressive face, crisp clusters and deliberate pixel edges. Keep the reference palette and material contrast while simplifying noisy micro-detail into clear pixel shapes. The result should feel hand-crafted in Aseprite and use PixelLab’s polished sprite rendering. Show the entire character from head to boots, centered, with breathing room on every side; no cropping. Three-quarter front view, neutral ready stance, both hands empty and visible. No weapon held, carried or sheathed; no shield; no text, props or scenery. Transparent background. One character only. Design a new rendering, do not paste or reproduce the source pixels.

styleImages.role: V4 image loaded through Aseprite PixelLab Set style; options copied: palette, outline, detail, shading
